events.factual_description: Jazz at Lincoln Center presents the Django Reinhardt NY Festival at Dizzy's Club from Wednesday, November 11 through Sunday, November 15, 2026. JALC lists 7:00 PM and 9:00 PM sets Wednesday through Saturday, with 5:00 PM and 7:30 PM sets Sunday. The core Django Festival Allstars lineup is Samson Schmitt on lead guitar, Ludovic Beier on accordion, Pierre Blanchard on violin, Antonio Licusati on bass, and Francko Mehrstein on rhythm guitar. JALC lists nightly special guests Tatiana Eva-Marie on November 11, Edmar Castaneda on November 12, Ute Lemper on November 13, Roberta Gambarini on November 14, and Van Gierig on November 15. JALC describes the France-based all-acoustic ensemble as celebrating more than 25 years of the festival and identifies Samson Schmitt as the son of guitarist Dorado Schmitt. The currently accessible Sunday ticket page lists a standard $50 face-value ticket plus a $5 fee and a $25 student reservation plus a $5 fee. Individual set availability varies; the exact purchase page should be checked before travel.

en.why_it_matters: The lineage is alive rather than museum-like: a France-based all-acoustic quintet led by Samson Schmitt carries the Schmitt family connection into guitar, accordion, violin, bass and rhythm guitar, then changes the conversation each night with a different guest voice or instrument. After more than 25 years, the New York festival has become its own transatlantic meeting point for Django's language, and the instrumental texture is specific enough to make this more than a repertory tribute.
en.trip_verdict: If a New York trip already overlaps, choose the guest pairing that pulls hardest and make room for one set at Dizzy's. Five nights and multiple sets make this easy to fit around a broader NYC music itinerary rather than building the entire corridor trip around it.

es.why_it_matters: El linaje está vivo, no convertido en pieza de museo: un quinteto acústico llegado de Francia y encabezado por Samson Schmitt prolonga la conexión familiar de los Schmitt entre guitarra, acordeón, violín, bajo y guitarra rítmica, y cada noche cambia la conversación con una voz o instrumento invitado distinto. Después de más de 25 años, el festival de Nueva York ya es un punto de encuentro transatlántico propio para el lenguaje de Django, y su textura instrumental es demasiado específica para reducirlo a un simple tributo de repertorio.
es.trip_verdict: Si un viaje a Nueva York ya coincide con esas fechas, escogería la combinación de invitado que más jale y le haría espacio a un set en Dizzy's. Cinco noches y varios horarios permiten acomodarlo dentro de una ruta musical más amplia por NYC sin construir todo el viaje del corredor alrededor de esta residencia.
